title: User Login with valid credentials
description: Verify that admin user can log in with correct username and password
steps: Enter 'admin' in the username input field
Enter 'admin123' in the password input field

title: Login with invalid credentials shows error
description: Verify error message appears when login credentials are wrong

title: Dashboard loads with summary cards
description: Verify the main dashboard displays case statistics and charts after login
steps: Check that dashboard cards are visible

title: Theme toggle between dark and light
description: Verify the theme toggle button switches between dark and light mode
steps: Locate the theme toggle button in the header
Verify the UI switches to light mode
Click the theme toggle button again
Verify the UI switches back to dark mode

title: Navigate to Clients page
description: Verify clients list page loads and displays data
steps: Click on Clients menu item in sidebar
Verify add client button is present

title: Navigate to Cases page
description: Verify cases list page loads with all controls
steps: Click on Cases menu item in sidebar
Check case filters and search are present
Verify add case button is visible

title: Navigate to Sessions page
description: Verify court sessions page loads with calendar view
steps: Click on Sessions menu item in sidebar
Check calendar or list view is displayed
Verify add session button is present

title: Navigate to Documents page
steps: Click on Documents menu item in sidebar
Check document upload button is present

title: Navigate to Tasks page
description: Verify task board page loads with columns
steps: Click on Tasks menu item in sidebar
Check task board columns are displayed
Verify add task button is present

title: Navigate to Reports dashboard
description: Verify reports dashboard loads with all report type cards
steps: Click on Reports menu item in sidebar
Check report type cards are displayed
Verify at least one report card is clickable

title: Navigate to Settings page
description: Verify settings page loads with configuration options

title: Sidebar navigation menu displays correctly
description: Verify all main navigation items are present in sidebar
steps: Verify Dashboard menu item is present
Verify Clients menu item is present
Verify Cases menu item is present
Verify Sessions menu item is present
Verify Documents menu item is present

title: POA (Power of Attorney) page loads
description: Verify Power of Attorney management page loads
steps: Check add POA button is present

title: Employees page loads and displays data
description: Verify employee management page loads correctly
steps: Check add employee button is present

title: Finance page loads with financial data
description: Verify finance management page loads with charts
steps: Check financial summary or charts are displayed
